title: MV Spacing between each equip slot

posts.author: Arkos
posts.body:
Hey guys!
I'm having a bit of an issue with getting my equip menu looking just right. Check the image below and you'll understand what I'm after. Basically, I want each equip slot to match my background image. As you can see the "sword" is positioned correctly but I want to space the other slots so that they too can look good. I'm using Moghunters equip menu plugin and I have looked through and changed values left and right but I just can't get it to add spacing vertically.
If you look to the left, you can see my parameters. I managed to add spacing to them without issue because Mog had included the line of code needed for this. I'm referring to "this.lineheight()", specifically. This line of code doesn't exist for the equip slots and I have no idea how to add spacing between each slot.
Will add that I have gone into the default rpg maker script files/plugins as well and made a lot of changes but none of if helped.
Unsure how to proceed so any help/hint/guidance/vague pointing at something or someone would be appreciated, thanks
